label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_00
text: I’m so sorry, everyone...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_system_01
text: About a year and a half ago...

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_01
text: I’m so sorry... I think I went a little too far...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_akuboss_01
text: Nah, don’t worry ’bout it.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_akuboss_02
text: We’re the ones who asked you to put us through\nsome tough battle practice so we can train up.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_01
text: Truly, you need not apologize, my lady.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_02
text: Thanks to thy sage instruction, I am making\nswift strides toward mastering the art of battle![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_fairyboss_01
text: And I could never have evolved my Pokémon\nwithout you, Eri![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_honooboss_01
text: Even the big boss said it’s thanks to you that we\nhave a fightin’ chance against our bullies![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_akuboss_03
text: See? Nothin’ but gratitude. To us, you’re the\nbrightest star in the whole team![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_03
text: Hehe. Come on, quit being silly![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_fairyboss_02
text: Um, just one thing...\c\nWe’ve been training for four whole hours now.\nI’m totally pooped.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_04
text: Ah, I’m sorry! You all really should take a break.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_05
text: I’ll go for a run while you rest up![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_dokuboss_03
text: My lady...we four have each trained in our turn—\nbut you, our steadfast mentor, have rested not\r\nonce. I cannot help but worry for thy health.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_06
text: Thank you for your concern, Atticus.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_07
text: But lately...I feel like I can take anything.\nEven if I’m really tired or feel like crying.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_08
text: Remember that time we all got together and\nriffed on the Gym Badge designs to create our\r\nvery own Star Badges?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_21
text: Well, I don’t know what it is, but just looking at\nmy Star Badge makes me feel so strong...\c\nLike I want to give it my all![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_09
text: I gave my all, but it wasn’t enough—\nI wasn’t enough...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_10
text: You showed amazing strength.\c\nEven if the code didn’t require me to give it to\nyou, I’d want you to have this.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_waza_01
text: I’d like to see you try out my trademark move,\ntoo! Here—this one’s for you.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_12
text: I know you’re part of Operation Starfall...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_13
text: But I could tell from our battle that you’re not a\nbad person.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_14
text: The way your Pokémon look[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0001)]s at you with such\ntrust gives it away.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_15
text: Do me a favor and look away for a moment?\nThis is a bit much for me to take...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_16
text: I just r-really...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_kakutouboss_17
text: RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_01
text: Looks like it’s all over.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_01
text: Oh, Riri...[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_02
text: This is the Team Star member you battled at the\ngates earlier. I asked her to come along for a talk.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_03
text: So, what did you want to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_08
text: You seem to be on much friendlier terms with Eri\ncompared to the other grunts.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_09
text: Why is that?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_04
text: Oh, you spotted that?\c\nWell, all right... I don’t mind telling you.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_05
text: Truth is, I used to hate Riri.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_10
text: [EMPTY 68]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_06
text: [EMPTY 68]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_07
text: She’s an amazing Trainer and athlete—and she’s\nreally pretty, too.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_08
text: It took her no time at all to become popular at\nthe academy.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_09
text: I was queen of the class before she came along,\nbut then everyone liked her more than me...[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_11
text: So let me guess...you started to pick on her?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_10
text: Pretty much. I got our classmates to join in, too...\nWe were all so stupid.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_11
text: [EMPTY 68]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_12
text: [EMPTY 68]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_12
text: But in the end, kids are always fickle—and once\none thrill wears off, they look for something new.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_13
text: Before long, the class chose me as their next\ntarget and started bullying me instead.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_13
text: [EMPTY 68]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_14
text: I guess I deserved it. But then Riri...she chose to\nhelp me even though I’d been so horrible to her.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_15
text: She told me that she understood how hard it is\nto have no one on your side...\c\nAnd she invited me into Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_14
text: Even after you bullied her like that... What a\nkind girl.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_16
text: She really is. And joining the team has worked\nout great for us. It’s been so much fun![VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_15
text: Fun? There are rumors that Team Star likewise\nengages in bullying...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_17
text: After hearing my story, do you really think\nthat’s true?[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_nelke_16
text: Ah, no... I merely...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_18
text: Riri and the rest of Team Star made me who I\nam today.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]

label: ajito_kakutou_040_sitappa_19
text: Please...don’t take away our greatest treasure.[VAR 0x0114(003F)]
